item.title: Man accused of sparking deadly Los Angeles wildfire found guilty
item.description:
A man accused of sparking the deadly 2025 Pacific Palisades wildfire that killed 12 people and destroyed nearly 7,000 homes was found guilty on all counts Friday after a federal retrial in Los Angeles , months after his first trial ended in a mistrial. Jonathan Rinderknecht, 30, a former Uber driver with dual U.S.-French citizenship, had been charged with two federal arson counts — including destruction of property by means of fire — in U.S. District Court . He was retried on a scaled-down grand jury indictment after his initial three-week trial ended in a hung jury in June. Ahead of the second trial, federal prosecutors dropped one of the original three charges against Rinderknecht, and modified the two remaining federal arson counts , reducing his maximum possible prison sentence from 45 years to 40 years.
